_comment: 8e Phase B canonical (issue #16, plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-12-8e-pallass.md, extended by the cross-lane reconciliation): teleport-based walkthrough of the two new Pallass maps -- the dungeon_peek precedent. No live route exists to either map yet (the portals `pallass` row gates on pallass_attuned, unbanked at default boot), so this stays the sole proof they render/work independent of the quest. Default boot (no fixture -- no beat here depends on player progression). Covers: bounds laps of each map's WALKABLE shelf rectangle (y2-9; y0-1/y10 are the wall/void bands) HARDENED with an up-bump at y1 and a down-bump at y10 (the stacked-band rows are provably solid, not just skipped); the PERMIT OFFICE (the reconciliation's fix -- forge_permit_clerk + Grimalkin hosting C's graphs, each conversation opened and exited via its hub's single fresh-state visible option: every gated option is requires-hidden at zero progress, so confirm-on-row-0 is the exit -- pinned at the conversation-id level, NOT copy, since D-phase replaces draft text); the stallkeeper's pallass_market_local conversation; the checkpoint clerk's pallass_market_clerk conversation; the elevator's locked read on BOTH sides (door_when unmet -- its producer is the office's own collect_stamp node, unbanked here); the landmark props; the molten seam's blocked bump; whole-run combat_started absence.

steps._comment: == ENTER pallass_market via teleport (unreachable any other way at default boot) ==

v0.15 T4.1 re-derived: +2 market observables (ordinance wall, public scales). blocked_cells is unchanged on purpose -- entities block their own cell in the SIM but the payload counts `blocked` + wall segments only. v0.16 #307 re-derived AGAIN, 25 -> 27: the den shop door (12,4) and the dray rank (16,4), both UNCONDITIONAL.
== band hardening: the wall band (y0-1) is genuinely blocked, not just unwalked -- an up-bump from the shelf's top row.
== bounds lap: the WALKABLE shelf rectangle (y2-9) -- right 25, down 7, then the void row's own down-bump (y10 solid), left 25, up 7 returns to (0,2) clean.

== the arrival anchor (4,6). It IS a portal carrier now, but this script boots with pallass_attuned unbanked, so the picker gate fails and the plain toast arm reads -- the carrier's own can-fail proof (pallass_round_trip walks the met side). WEST approach (3,6), the same one pallass_round_trip takes home: the south cell (4,7) is alchemy_bench_reduction, solid, and standing inside it is what v0.15 moved the arrival off. Slate recolor read (anchor_waystone_slate).

payload_contains.text: Cold, precise stone, and not as blank as it looks. Something the shape of a door is being held in it, patiently, for later.

steps._comment: == the checkpoint clerk (7,5) -- hosts C's pallass_market_clerk graph. Fresh state: the 2g stamp option is requires-hidden (pallass_attuned 0), only the exit is visible -- confirm on row 0 closes. Pinned at conversation-id level (copy is D-phase-replaceable).
== the posted prices (9,6) -- the anti-Invrisil tell.

payload_contains.text: Chalk and slate. The numbers don't move for anyone.

steps._comment: == a market stall (12,6) -- one of three IDENTICAL stalls, uniformity is the QUALIFY tell.

== the stallkeeper (15,5), behind stall_b -- hosts C's pallass_market_local graph (the race-variant walk-on). Approach from (14,5): the sideways bump faces her, then interact opens the conversation. Class-foundation pass R5 (2026-07-12) added the sell surface as row 0 ('Anything on you worth my coin?', trader_earn_loop's own job) -- row 1 ('Morning.') is now the plain dismissal this peek wants, unchanged.
== v0.15 T4.1 market observable 1/2: the ordinance case (10,3), the tier's north dead band. South approach (10,4), bump-face up. ==
Default boot: elevator_pass_stamped unbanked, so the base toast reads and the permit-keyed `variants` arm cannot match -- the can-fail side of the market's reactivity pass.

payload_contains.text: Numbered, dated, and locked under glass. You read four of them and put your hands back in your pockets.

steps._comment: == v0.15 T4.1 market observable 2/2: the public scales (14,8). North approach off the parapet row (14,9). ==

payload_contains.text: You set a hand on the pan and it swings back level. The chained weights have inspection dates stamped into them, the last one this month.

steps._comment: == THE PERMIT OFFICE (19-21,4) -- the reconciliation's fix. The forge-tier clerk hosts C's pallass_forge_clerk graph (beats 1+3, the elevator_pass_stamped producer). Fresh state: every chain option is requires-hidden, only 'not now' visible -- confirm row 0 closes.

== Grimalkin (18,3), MOVED here from the forge tier (he examines applicants BEFORE they descend) -- hosts C's pallass_grimalkin graph (the 8g exam, beat 2). Fresh state: the exam option is requires-hidden (forge_permit_filed 0), the b4 #219 studies row 'About the studies.' (board_accepted:false, MET here) is row 0 and the exit is row 1 -- down 1 before confirm.

== the market-tier elevator gate (22,7) -- LOCKED read (door_when unmet; the producer is the office's collect_stamp node, unbanked this run). Approach from (23,7), bump-face left into the occupied gate cell.

payload_contains.text: The brass gate is locked. A stencilled plate: PERMIT AND STAMP REQUIRED. The clerk's window is open.

steps._comment: == ENTER pallass_forge via teleport ==

v0.15 T4.1 re-derived: the tier went from 6 interactables and nobody to 15 (T4.4 adds the fetch slips) -- +2 NPCs (smith, lift attendant) and +6 observables. v0.16 #307 re-derived AGAIN, 16 -> 20: the forge hall door (15,3), the reject bin (10,4), the landing manifest (23,4) and the held pallet (19,4), all UNCONDITIONAL, so the count moves in every state and this pin is the only place it is asserted. blocked_cells stays 85 for the reason above -- entities block in the SIM, not in this payload.
== band hardening + bounds lap, same shape as the market's.
== the Magus's bench (7,5) -- Grimalkin's old post, now DRESSING (he examines up at the market office). The observe copy carries the pointer.

payload_contains.text: Every tool squared to the bench edge. You decide against touching anything.

steps._comment: == the molten seam (13-17,5) -- SPARING: one dominant channel, the map's whole molten budget. A bump proves it's genuinely blocked, not just decor.
== a forge station (10,6) -- the one carrying the furnace-glow light, the [Tactician]/[Engineer] observe content.
== v0.15 T4.1 forge observables, west to east across what used to be 253 empty cells. 1/3: the tool wall (2,3), south approach. ==

payload_contains.text: You lift a set of tongs off its outline and set it back. Heavier than it looks, and it goes back exactly straight.

steps._comment: == 2/3: the parapet rail (24,6) -- the tier's open edge beside the lift landing. ==

payload_contains.text: You lean on the bronze rail. Warm brass under your palm; from the shaft, cold air and the clank of the cage somewhere below.

steps._comment: == 3/3: the slag heap (19,6), the tier's east working end. ==

payload_contains.text: Glassy black waste, still holding a little of the day's heat. Even the refuse up here has a level marked on it.

steps._comment: == the forge-tier elevator gate (22,7) -- same LOCKED read as the market side (verbatim copy, the shared bureaucracy).

payload_contains.text: The brass gate is locked. A stencilled plate: PERMIT AND STAMP REQUIRED. The clerk's window is open.

steps._comment: Scope guard: neither map carries a live combat trigger -- whole-run negative proof.
